message.content: {"accepted_answers": ["1886", "1892", "1900", "1855"], "explanation": "The documents contain conflicting or distinct references to different individuals named Robert Hutchinson: one was elected in 1886 (South Australia), another in 1892 (Geraldton Town Council) and 1900 (Western Australian Legislative Assembly), and a third became mayor in 1855 (Charlottetown); the 1974 date appears to be an error in the text conflating names."}
